validated_objective: Release QIF v0.6.33 with consequence-sensitive calibration that makes asymmetric decision errors reproducible and governed while preserving QIF's verifier boundary.
scope: Extend calibration-report schema with consequence policies, per-pair decision consequence records, and aggregate consequence assessments.
Reproduce source loss-boundary linkage, threshold action, false assurance and false alarm classification, applied governance-priority weight, and aggregate arithmetic.
Add governance forcing, example package, retained negative fixtures, plain-language documentation, roadmap and release evidence.
constraints: Remain standalone, domain-general, and inside the existing calibration-report package.
Do not monetize human harm, claim objective utility, compare weights across policies, or grant automatic decision authority.
Do not add UI, external integrations, production data, or unrelated package redesign.
expected_outcomes: Humans and AI agents can explain why two similarly sized forecast errors have different governed consequence treatment.
npm test rejects broken threshold, classification, source loss-boundary, arithmetic, boundary, and governance traces.
